notes: The Pocket Prayer Book now opens inside the app. Tap a section like Common Prayers to read its prayers right there, and tap it again to close it.
new: Every Pocket Prayer Book section (Common Prayers, Blessed Trinity, Our Lady and the rest) now opens inside the app, with the section name centered and the prayers shown below it. It works without internet.
Tap the section name again, or the Close button at the bottom, to go back to the list.
changed: English + Latin now shows the Latin under each prayer that has one.
Each section still has a link to its full page on opusdei.org for prayers that are only on the website.
